set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-temporal.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: b8f22d00 temporal/scanner declared-contract component is landed with evidence/temporal-scanner-20260922. Synthetic declarations do not establish actual scanner origins or the complete temporal journey.

Remaining / next action: Finish recall exposure, concentration/disconnected mass queries, paired facade/exchange and provider-owned Atlas handoff. Preserve allocation-free support, declared kernels, missing/unprojectable ledgers and exact axes.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md; ADR 0019. Repository: storymodel4s.

Scope: align, recall, view, codec, pipeline, fixtures

Acceptance criteria:
1. Derive temporal measures from discrete checked mapping units and occurrence-qualified exact source support. Distinguish target ambiguity, genuine multiple referents, extent/allocation, timing uncertainty, external states and computation failure. No source-only or top-k renormalization.
2. Provide allocation-free support bounds and optional explicitly named uniform kernels over interval unions, with point atoms handled separately. Available kernels are nonnegative unit-mass measures; unavailable allocation stays in a ledger. Probability-valued results require checked normalized assignment semantics; score/transport measures retain their units. Expose a checked downstream derivation/codec extension without activating reserved G1 authority by a label.
3. Recall exposure preserves gaps/overlap policy and does not invent offsets from the next onset. Queries by unit, recall time, encoding region and grid return the same quantities; inverse-region contributions are not a reverse posterior without an explicit prior. Word display projection does not create independent observations.
4. Return mass within a declared time window, best-window concentration and disconnected mass sets, with unattainable coverage and candidate coverage explicit. Broad support cannot imply fine precision. Coherent run-level clock uncertainty is separate from per-unit assignment; joint/path quantities require joint evidence or a declared approximation.
5. Produce sparse weights and multiresolution query/view packets keyed by mapping/projection/axis/policy identities. Crop/rebin/top-k preserve ledgers and mass; support-only views stay unallocated. Provider-owned scientific compilation feeds StoryAtlas; view-side layout does not change scientific values.
6. Integrate temporal query/export capabilities into the existing facade and exchange bundle; no bench import or parallel mapping schema. Independent Python/R reader reproduces region queries and grid weights. Fixtures include narrow/broad/multimodal, repeated media, disjoint/point support, untimed, external and failed cases; wrong joins and lossy >2^53 conversions refuse.
7. Publish an exact producer revision, schema/query versions, generator command, fixture digests, expected results and gate receipts for the blocked StoryAtlas consumer. Browser completion remains in StoryAtlas. No second-level empirical accuracy claim follows from these synthetic courts.

Boundary: Post-G1/M1-producer extension; does not expand the active G1 or fixed-cut M1 landing. Basic timing/exchange can close first; calibration, fine localization and neural analysis are separate.

Implementation evidence: exact baseline/result revisions, bound commands/test totals/exit, artifact digests, independent known answers, one failing mutation with an accepting control per guarantee, compatibility impact and separate cold review. StoryModel uses tools/reference-scope.sh and clean exact-revision sbt -batch checkAll. Proposed suites are acceptance specifications until implemented. No held-out corpus read, hosted spend, recruitment, publication or calibration is authorized by this engineering ticket.
